source.sqlReaderQuery: SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED 	DECLARE @CURRENT_DATE AS DATETIME; 	SET @CURRENT_DATE = GETDATE(); 			 SELECT	DISTINCT  			 SBSB.SBSB_ID + '00' MEMBER                 			,MEME.MEME_MEDCD_NO 'ALTKEY' 			,MEME.MEME_LAST_NAME 			,MEME.MEME_FIRST_NAME 			,MEPE.PDPD_ID 			,MEPE.CSCS_ID 			,CSPI.PLAN_IDENTIFIER FROM		(SELECT GRGR_CK, PDPD_ID, CSPI_ID, CSCS_ID,                 CASE 				WHEN PDPD_ID  IN ('INPLUS00','INPLUS01','INTEMP00')									 THEN 'HCC' 				WHEN PDPD_ID  IN ('INBASCH0','INBASCHR','INBASI1R','INBASIC0','INBASIC1','INBASICR') THEN 'HHW' 				WHEN PDPD_ID  IN ('INHIPBA0','INHIPBA1','INHIPBA2','INHIPBA3','INHIPBA4','INHIPPL0', 								  'INHIPPL2','INHIPPL3','INHIPPL4','INHIPPRE','INHPEBAR','INHPEBAS', 								  'INHPEBAT','INHPEBAU','INHPSPB0','INHPSPB2','INHPSPB3','INHPSPB4', 								  'INHPSPP0','INHPSPP2','INHPSPP3','INHPSPP4','INTEMP01')			 THEN 'HIP'  			         ELSE 'OTH' END 'PLAN_IDENTIFIER'               FROM ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_CSPI_CS_PLAN                WHERE GRGR_CK = 90) CSPI   INNER JOIN	ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG  MEPE ON MEPE.GRGR_CK = CSPI.GRGR_CK AND MEPE.PDPD_ID = CSPI.PDPD_ID AND MEPE.CSCS_ID = CSPI.CSCS_ID AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'  AND	@CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT and MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT  INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEME_MEMBER  MEME ON			MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK AND			MEME.GRGR_CK = MEPE.GRGR_CK INNER JOIN  ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB   ON			MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK  AND			MEPE.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK

SELECT 'HCC' PLAN_IDENTIFIER ,'BD' PostcardType,'BD' FormatTypee
UNION ALL

SELECT 'HCC'  ,'PROV' ,'PROV'

UNION ALL
